accepted_record_constructors.ComparatorSchedule: Use each frozen to_ecj1 payload and ENVELOPE(case,role,payload); validate the full accepted ebu.object-content.v1 preimage and exact payload before using the envelope-derived ObjectRef.
accepted_record_constructors.GroupReceipt: Same accepted envelope rule over the frozen settlement.GroupReceipt payload; group_ref and measurement_ref obey the acyclic link law.
accepted_record_constructors.SameBaselineNonadditivityWitness: Same accepted envelope rule over the frozen D2 payload; empty_baseline is Q(...,'0/1') and every row is ALGEBRAIC_IDENTITY with exactly the accepted required nonclaims in canonical order: NO_EMPIRICAL_VALIDATION, NO_CAUSAL_IDENTIFICATION, NO_RUNTIME_BEHAVIOR, NO_SETTLEMENT_ENTITLEMENT, NO_PHYSICAL_PHASE_INTERFERENCE.
accepted_record_constructors.SerialComparatorInteractionWitness: Same accepted envelope rule and exact five-code D2 nonclaim set over each comparator payload; aligned schedule/order/value fields equal the corresponding bridge row.

construction_language.bridge_record_constructor: For each frozen bridge record, materialize dependencies first, compute the exact listed to_ecj1 object, build ENVELOPE(case,role,payload), validate its full accepted preimage and payload equality, then call the exact keyword-only constructor with that envelope plus the typed values whose accepted projections equal the listed payload.

common_structural_profile.receipt_rule: M2-M9 construct the acyclic group -> diagnostics/comparator -> GroupMeasurement -> accepted GroupReceipt DAG and preserve both ordered child receipt refs. Any authorized institutional values and explicit residual closure are validated and embedded in GroupMeasurement before the receipt; downstream accepted settlement records may point forward to the receipt. M1 has no physical group or receipt.

envelope_constructor.name: ENVELOPE
envelope_constructor.object_content_hash: SHA-256 of the exact accepted ebu.object-content.v1 preimage [authority_refs, hash_domain, object_content_payload, object_id, object_kind, object_version, schema_id, schema_version, supersedes_ref], with supersedes represented as null in that preimage
envelope_constructor.object_content_payload: CanonicalBytes of exact ECJ-1 payload without LF
envelope_constructor.object_kind_and_schema: ScientificId values from exact record_surfaces below; SemanticVersion('1.0.0')
envelope_constructor.rule: validate_object_envelope must succeed and its payload must equal the record to_ecj1 before the envelope-derived ObjectRef is used; no new hash domain exists.

construction_language.frozen_endpoint_rule: FROZEN_BASELINE_ENDPOINT carries required_input and endpoint; evaluator rejects every other input and makes no general transformation claim.
construction_language.group_profile_rule: M1 supplies a complete empty relation plus explicit separability evidence and yields zero JointTransitionGroup values. Each M2-M9 profile supplies one exact overlapping DependencyEdge, dependency_relation_complete=true, and one fully declared two-child connected component with all common fields; classify validates but does not create or discover it.
construction_language.interface_argument_rule: Each T2 wrapper parses the full future fixture document, selects exactly one case_id authorized by its capability, materializes that case's entire record graph from bytes, invokes no other public wrapper, and returns only the exact interface_expected_outputs member for its own interface.
construction_language.isolation: Each case is freshly materialized; no returned SystemState exists and no wrapper output is valid wrapper input.

opcode_definitions.semantics: Return the supplied scalar/vector state byte-for-value unchanged.
Return x+delta.
Add delta to exactly the named coordinate and preserve every other coordinate.
Componentwise exact addition; state and delta dimensions must be equal.
Return a*x+b exactly.
Return value for every admitted scalar input.
Return max(0,x-delta), comparing exact rationals.
Return the exact sum of coordinate squares.
Return sum_j (x_j-target_j)^2; lists have equal nonzero length.
Return (x-target)^2 exactly.
Return the exact named scalar coordinate as distortion.
Return the exact square of the named scalar coordinate.
Return primary^2+lambda*resource exactly; resource is never discarded.

arguments: request_by_action:exact map from action-a/action-b to positive rational
target_coordinate_by_action:exact map from action-a/action-b to distinct state coordinate
opcode_definitions.semantics: Read actions in exact action_ref order. If total request exceeds capacity, accept capacity*request[action]/sum(requests) for each action; otherwise accept its request. Add each accepted value to its declared target coordinate and subtract their sum from capacity.

arguments: accepted_by_action:exact map from action-a/action-b to nonnegative rational
target_coordinate_by_action:exact map from action-a/action-b to distinct state coordinate
ordering supplied by standalone or aligned quantity-fixed comparator program
opcode_definitions.semantics: For each named action in the supplied program order, apply exactly its already accepted quantity: require it not to exceed remaining capacity, add it to the declared target coordinate, and subtract it from capacity. A standalone program invokes exactly one action from baseline; a quantity-fixed serial comparator invokes AB or BA without replaying the request rule.

arguments: request_by_action:exact map from action-a/action-b to positive rational
target_coordinate_by_action:exact map from action-a/action-b to distinct state coordinate
ordering supplied by aligned comparator program
opcode_definitions.semantics: For each action in the named comparator order, accept min(request_by_action[action],remaining capacity), add it to target_coordinate_by_action[action], and reduce remaining capacity exactly.
Return endpoint iff input equals required_input exactly; every other input is outside the witness and rejected.

quantity_constructor.name: Q
quantity_constructor.resolution: ResolutionState.PRESENT; present_value_ref=REF(case_id,'present-'+role); completed/missing refs empty; due/failure/boundary-edge/reason are Applicability.NOT_APPLICABLE

construction_language.scalar_and_vector_literals: Reduced exact rational strings n/d; denominator positive; no float, exponent, NaN, Infinity, or implicit tolerance.

synthetic_reference_constructor.name: REF
synthetic_reference_constructor.opaque_object_content_hash: sha256:<lowercase SHA-256 of ECJ-1 bytes without LF for {'case_id':case_id,'role':role,'synthetic_status':'SYNTHETIC_NONSCIENTIFIC'}>
synthetic_reference_constructor.rule: REF constructs only fixture-confined opaque external evidence links; it never claims to construct an accepted record ObjectContentHash. Role is unique within a case and no registry lookup occurs.

cross_document_checks: same 8 types/8 callables and exact signatures
same exact future fixture bytes/hash/blob and 36-row allowlist
same seven record projections and acyclic receipt link law
same topology nondependency and lifecycle boundary
all source/predecessor/implementation identities match exact raw bytes and Git objects
same closed 297-row FailureId assignment, 73-coordinate catalogue, exact preimages and IDs, owning-interface provenance, and benign-repeat/collision audit
exact_arithmetic_checks: All rationals parse to arbitrary-precision numerator/denominator and are reduced before comparison.
For each physical group row, EBU_G = D0-DG exactly.
For each DEFINED N row, N_G = EBU_G-sum(singleton EBU) exactly.
For each DEFINED comparator row, I = EBU_G-EBU_seq = D_seq-D_G exactly.
M2 quantity-fixed and rule-replayed paths are checked separately.
M6 uses lambda exactly 1/1 and checks EBU_G=-2/1, N_G=2/1, I=0/1.
M8 checks I_AB=-13/4 and I_BA=15/4 and their inequality.
M9 contains Applicability.NOT_APPLICABLE and no serialized numeric N_G, EBU_seq, or interaction value.
Any future supplied settlement checks sum(shares)+residual=EBU_G exactly; the frozen matrix supplies no shares.
STATIC-RECEIPT-BATCHING-001 proves 9/1-6/1=3/1=(3-1)*2/1-1/1 and is a static source-law check, never a T2 scientific mapping and never included in physical EBU projections.

accepted_derivation.digest_rule: raw SHA-256 of the exact FailureIdPreimageV1 bytes; prefix the lowercase 64-hex digest with ebu:failure:core:sha256-
accepted_derivation.frame_rule: FRAME(x)=UINT64_BE(len(UTF8(x)))||UTF8(x); decimal integers use minimal unsigned ASCII
preimage_order: applicable interface module, qualname, and interface_version frames
ordered object_id, object_version, and object_content_hash frames for each object ref

failure_identity_contract.closed_coordinate_rule: Every assignment resolves exactly one coordinate_ref. Every catalogue row states every accepted FailureId coordinate without defaults: failure code, stage, complete interface reference, exact ordered object-reference array, event key, and ordinal. No runtime choice, alias expansion, or representative owner is permitted.

collision_audit.benign_repetition_rule: A repeated coordinate is benign only when stage, code, complete interface reference, ordered object references, event key, and ordinal are byte-identical and all assigned vectors expect that same first failure at that exact owning boundary. Distinct invalid inputs are excluded from FailureIdPreimageV1.

projection_protocol.rule: canonical JSON plus LF for each named closed subprojection

dynamic_components_in_hybrid_rows: M4 standalone and both serial IDENTITY paths
M5 standalone and both serial CLAMPED_DECREASE paths

independent_validation_routes.canonical_json_encoder_1: Python standard-library json.dumps(sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False) plus LF after strict duplicate/nonfinite parse.
